items.label: Bird Scare Reflectors
items.value: Crafted from high-definition mirror materials, our bird repellent devices outdoor are safe for animals and serve a dual purpose by stopping birds from nesting on porches and hitting windows. It's an ideal solution for protecting gardens, patios,orchards,crops,pools,boats,cars, and other valuable assets from avian intrusion

items.label: Scare Birds Away
items.value: Featuring large 24 pcs Discs, this bird scare device maximizes its bird-scaring presence. The multi-faceted refraction points, combined with the motion from the wind, effectively scare away, confuse, and prevent woodpeckers, pigeon and other birds from becoming accustomed to the environment, with optimal results achieved in direct sunlight and a gentle breeze

items.label: Easy Installation and Customization
items.value: The double-sided reflective discs are simple to hang anywhere needed. They are not pre-assembled, allowing for customizable configurations and the ability to link multiple discs together for extended coverage, depending on the area you want to protect

items.label: Versatility with Aesthetic Appeal
items.value: Beyond its functional bird-deterring capabilities, this bird scare disc doubles as an attractive outdoor ornament. Its lightweight, reflective mirrors plastic construction is both durable and weather-resistant, creating a spiral shadow and intense reflections under the sun and breeze to deter birds. The reflective mirrors are larger and less prone to cracking, offering superior reflection
